analyst_view.overall: Early view: two sides on one point that need a win. Pafos lost 3-1 at Atalanta and at Twente and drew 1-1 with Riga; Midtjylland lead the Danish Superliga unbeaten but have one point in Europe after a 6-1 home defeat to Ajax. Both lose a player sent off in their last European game: Lelê for Pafos at Twente and Kjell-Arik Wätjen for Midtjylland against Ajax, so these bans apply here.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean higher: both defences have leaked seven goals in three European games, and Midtjylland's Danish league form (27 goals in 13 games) shows they can score. Pafos lose Lelê, who scored at Twente in the game he was sent off, which hurts their attack, but both sides need to win and should open up.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners. Pafos at home and Midtjylland both like to attack, which the number already reflects; I see nothing to move it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. I lean higher: both teams had a man sent off last time out in Europe, both are near the bottom of the table and need the win, and that tends to make games more stretched and fractious.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.0 shots. Both sides will push for the win, which supports a high count, but that is already in the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target. Weak defending on both sides supports a decent count, while Lelê's absence takes away one of Pafos's main finishers. I stay with the number.
